name: ral-mechanism-f0-horizon12
primary_estimand: coverage interaction: (restart-warm) with branches minus (restart-warm) without branches
prediction_status: Retrospective three-way split of a previously inspected dataset; not a pristine new-data test.
secondary_contrasts: restart_branch_effect: restart planning, wam_branch minus wam_demo
future_vs_current_branch_policy: reactive policy, wam_branch minus current_branch
current_branch_vs_demo_policy: reactive policy, current_branch minus current_demo
restart_branch_vs_bc: wam_branch restart planning minus bc policy
the primary interaction and all four contrasts above for success rate
descriptive_outcomes: success rate, mean maximum coverage and episode length for every condition, method and training seed
selected-plan checks along each planner's own trajectory: plan error, expected gain, real gain
wam_* prediction on test demonstrations: factual state nMSE, persistence, counterfactual nMSE, zero-action reference, block position RMSE
precision_rule: Seed count fixed at 15 in advance, using the variance observed in ral-mechanism-v1 and v2. dev-precision is reported for information only and does not change the seed count.
derived_from: ral-mechanism-v2 with the dynamics training horizon set to the planner horizon (12 instead of 5), branches of 16 steps instead of 8 so that 12-step branch windows exist, and new development and final banks. Code, demonstrations, conditions, endpoint and analysis are unchanged. Counterfactual prediction seeds are fixed in code and therefore shared with v2. Results are not pooled with v2.
cross_study_descriptive: Descriptive only: restart and warm coverage of wam_demo and wam_branch minus the same seed's ral-evidence-v2 value. Initial parameters match by seed across studies, but minibatches and training windows differ.
